  public: pkg/chaos/netem/**
  volatility: high
  layer: core
  allowed dependencies: pkg_chaos
  rules that apply:
    graph: a dependency between two modules must be an allowed dependency (ask: an owner may approve)
    coupling: new knowledge across a module boundary needs a balance of at least 8 (deny: fix the code)
    duplication: knowledge that another module already owns is not copied (ask: an owner may approve)
    layers: dependencies follow the layer order (deny: fix the code)
    docker-sdk-in-runtime: github.com/docker/docker is used only in pkg_runtime
      why: One adapter owns the Docker API.
